_comment: PteroSync Soak: fake game servers and a checker bot for testing PteroSync. Not a game.
name: PteroSync Soak
author: noreply@pterosync.invalid
description: Soak test for PteroSync: a fake game server that writes numbered chat, or the checker bot that measures delivery in Discord. See soak/README.md.
startup: if [ "${SOAK_ROLE}" = "checker" ]; then python -m pip install --user --quiet --disable-pip-version-check --no-warn-script-location discord.py==2.7.1 aiohttp==3.14.3 && exec python checker.py; else exec python fake_game.py; fi

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# PteroSync Soak installer: writes the soak scripts.
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server
echo '' | base64 -d > fake_game.py
echo '' | base64 -d > checker.py
echo "Installed the PteroSync soak scripts"

variables.name: Role
variables.description: game: a fake game server. checker: the checker bot.

variables.name: Game
variables.description: Console format of the fake game.

variables.name: Tag
variables.description: Short name in messages (letters and digits). Default: from the game.

variables.name: Checker bot token
variables.description: Checker only: token of a second Discord bot.

variables.name: Soak channels
variables.description: Checker only: chat channel IDs of the fake servers, comma separated.

variables.name: Report channel
variables.description: Checker only: channel for reports (default: first soak channel).

variables.name: Ping seconds
variables.description: Checker only: seconds between Discord -> game round-trip checks.

variables.name: Panel URL
variables.description: Checker only, optional: panel URL for the agent's memory.

variables.name: Panel API key
variables.description: Checker only, optional: a client API key that can see the agent server.

variables.name: Agent server
variables.description: Checker only, optional: the agent server's identifier (8 characters).
